description: Iteration 1 (no feedback yet): tune only F1 red running/early start and F2 space-seeking levers towards the observation targets; car-following values kept at Saval.

driver_archetypes.rationale: Kept at Saval Table 11 values: M1/car discharge headway and M6 car times have no feedback yet to justify a change; cars stop at red (M3/share/car 0.004).
Share kept at 0.1: car space seeking is only a small part of M8/car (0.068 wrong-lane share), moving it needs feedback first.
Saval motorcycle values kept; share lowered to 0.8 because moto_seeker rises to 0.2 (the shares of the moto distribution sum to 1).

Share raised 0.1 -> 0.2 so enough riders can take the sidewalk / right lane to reach M10a (0.56 sidewalk riders per cycle) and M9a (0.57 straight vehicles per cycle in the right-turn lane); with share 0.1 the observed rates are likely unreachable.
jmTimegapMinor kept at 1.0 s: M7a/M7b targets (5.6 waiters, 2.8 s release) cannot be adjusted without feedback on the box behaviour; sole archetype of its distribution, so share 1.

traci_rules.rationale: M3/share/moto observed 0.098 (and 0.5 in the base spec is far too high): p0 = 0.12 for a rider reaching the line on red; small k = 0.03 gives the mild clustering of M3/var_to_mean 1.14, capped at 0.25.

M2/early/moto observed 0.130 share (cars 0.011, not in this rule) while p = 0 gives 0; p = 0.15 per front-row rider within the last 7 s of red (inside the 4-10 s lead time) raises the early-start share towards 0.13.

Observed choices occur at queue about 15 m (M9c 15.7 m, M10b 15.3 m) and M5 queue is 15.8 m, so q = 15 m triggers draws at the observed queue; p_sidewalk 0.2 targets M10a 0.56/cycle, p_right_lane 0.1 targets M9a 0.57/cycle and M9b 0.065 blocked share, p_wrong_lane 0.2 follows observed 0.19-0.23 at low queue (M8 moto 0.25); sum 0.5 <= 1.
